text:
Predicates:
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
Nazi(x) ::: x is a Nazi.
MemberOf(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Reichstag(x) ::: x is the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
HeinrichScmidt ::: Heinrich Scmidt.
Nazi(heinrichscmidt) ::: Heinrich Scmidt was a Nazi German politician.
MemberOf(heinrichscmidt, PrussianStateParliament) ::: He was a member of the Prussian State Parliament.
MemberOf(heinrichscmidt, NaziReichstag) ::: He was a member of the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Politician(x) ∧ Reichstag(x)) ::: No politicians are part of the Nazi Reichstag.
